title: Checking Secrets into Version Control
pattern: Hardcoding secrets, API tokens, passwords, or cryptographic keys directly into source code or tracking them in files checked into git repositories.
why_bad: Exposes critical operational credentials to anyone with read access to the repository. It makes credential rotation extremely difficult since git history retains deleted secrets.
detection: The presence of raw, high-entropy cryptographic strings or known credential patterns (e.g. `auth_key = "..."`) in source code or tracked YAML/JSON configurations.
fix: Utilize dedicated external secret vaults or KMS environments; resolve secrets dynamically at runtime, using mock providers during development and testing.
source: Heather Adkins et al., - *Building Secure and Reliable Systems* (2020, O'Reilly Media).pdf, Chapter 14.
